notes.title: Season Festival Update & Full Released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43725369/726a4c8fde1508461abac4e2879ae69814eb5394.png[/img]

[b]Hello, players of [i]Story of Animal Sprite[/i]![/b]
Thank you for your patience! We are thrilled to announce that our game will be [b]FULL RELEASED[/b] on Steam with exciting new content!~
There will also be [b]discounts[/b] available, and we hope everyone can enjoy merging!

Get ready to embark on an unforgettable journey as we introduce the eagerly anticipated new system: [b]Seasonal Festival[/b]. Brace yourself for a captivating experience like no other!

With the update, a new structure called the [b]Festival Cannon[/b] will appear. By selecting the desired number of festival days and confirming the required resources, players can initiate the Seasonal Festival corresponding to the current season in game.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43725369/523eefa08ed0026d1bfa82a05a5413a0786c55c4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43725369/7160147e189789bf25ad270bbf8d21ecd2dbd036.png[/img][/url]

[list]
[*]During the festival, floating objects will transform into limited edition items specific to the season. Players can collect these floating objects to craft over[b] 70 new items[/b] associated with the respective seasons. SO BEAUTIFUL!
[*]Additionally, opening the crafted Seasonal Gift Boxes during the festival can reveal [b]4 seasonal exclusive animals[/b]. SO ADORABLE!
[*]We have also included over [b]10 explorable locations[/b]. Get ready to pack your bags and embark on an adventure with the little animals!
[*]Steam achievements corresponding to the new content will also be available upon the update.
[/list]
This Four Seasons update is our sincere creation, and if you enjoy it, we kindly ask you to recommend it to your friends. Welcome everyone to spend leisurely time in this forest!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2301850/Story_of_Animal_Sprite/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43725369/bbc8147b0a63e1f2204f134ad6b2f94d02c76ffa.png[/img]

notes.title: V0.2.02 Update
notes.content:
Hello, everyone.

We've recently recieved requests from you for more resolution, so we're adding new resolutions to choose with this update.

Including:
2560*1440
3840*2160
3440*1440

Please leave your review if you think the game is interesting, The Story of Animal Sprite is the first game of Alonds, each review is critical to us.
